import sys

input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
n, k = map(int, input[0].split())
passwords = input[1:-1]
codehorses_password = input[-1]

lengths = [len(password) for password in passwords]
sorted_lengths = sorted(set(lengths))

best_time = 1

worst_time = 0
wrong_tries = 0

for length in sorted_lengths:
    count = lengths.count(length)
    if codehorses_password in [p for p in passwords if len(p) == length]:
        worst_time += 1
        break
    else:
        for _ in range(count):
            worst_time += 1
            wrong_tries += 1
            if wrong_tries == k:
                worst_time += 5
                wrong_tries = 0

print(best_time, worst_time)
